title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
authors: T. Schick, J. Dwivedi-Yu, R. Dessì, et al. (8 authors)
before: Tool use was taught with human demonstrations or elaborate prompting.
problem: Demonstrations are expensive and do not transfer to new tools.
breakthrough: Let the model insert candidate API calls into text, keep the ones that reduce its own loss, and fine-tune on those.
why: It framed tool use as something a model can learn by itself from its own uncertainty.
next: Function calling APIs made tool use a product feature months later.
inherits: Tool calls as tokens the model emits, rather than an external orchestration layer.
